stem: The Group 2 elements $\text{Mg}$ to $\text{Ba}$ are all silvery-white reactive metals.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Draw a labelled diagram to show the bonding and structure of the Group 2 metals at room temperature.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why $\text{Mg}$ has a higher electrical conductivity than $\text{Na}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction of magnesium with cold water.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Identify a single reagent that can be used to distinguish separate samples of dilute $\text{Mg(NO}_3\text{)}_2\text{(aq)}$ and dilute $\text{Ba(NO}_3\text{)}_2\text{(aq)}$.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Describe what is observed when $\text{SrI}_2\text{(aq)}$ reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Compound $\mathbf{X}$, an anhydrous Group 2 bromide, is dissolved in water and titrated against aqueous silver nitrate.

A solution containing $0.250\text{ g}$ of $\mathbf{X}$ requires $33.65\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.0500\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{AgNO}_3\text{(aq)}$ for complete reaction.

Identify $\mathbf{X}$.

Show your working.
